The geometry leads to the equation  

\[
\frac{s^{2}}{25}+ \frac{81r^{2}}{100}= \frac{r^{2}+s^{2}}{4},
\]

which simplifies to  

\[
-21s^{2}+56r^{2}=0\;\Longrightarrow\; \frac{s^{2}}{r^{2}}=\frac{56}{21}= \frac{8}{3}.
\]

Hence  

\[
\frac{s}{r}= \sqrt{\frac{8}{3}} = \frac{2\sqrt6}{3}.
\]

ANSWER: \(\displaystyle \frac{2\sqrt6}{3}\)
